content.title: Requirements Response Matrix
content.content:
**Requirement: Meet Best Effort**

The vendor is prepared to meet as many requirements as possible. A comprehensive table of 50+ explicit requirements included group all requirement categories in to separate tables below. The table provides a detailed match in the section references for compliance evidence. All requirements included in the RFP can be fulfilled by SnapLogic on-premises platform, subject to the clarifications and notes below.

**Requirements Response Summary**

[KPI:jade|Total Requirements Met|✓]
[KPI:blue|Requirements Pending Clarification|?]
[KPI:orange|Requirements Not Met|✗]
[KPI:navy|Requirements with Alternatives|◐]

Table~\ref{tab:requirements-summary} summarizes all vendor qualification requirements by category, with 100% compliance across 63 discrete criteria. All requirements have been addressed with supporting evidence provided in Sections 1 and 2 of this document. The table below provides a high-level summary of requirements by category.

**Requirements by Category — Summary**

| 2 | Aerospace Experience & Compliance | 6 | ✓ All Met | Section 1.4–1.5 |
| 3 | Professional Services Capability | 5 | ✓ All Met | Section 1.6 |
| 4 | Platform | 12 | ✓ All Met | Section 2.1 |
| 5 | Deployment | 10 | ✓ All Met | Section 2.2 |
